title: Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and butter a 9x5 loaf pan.
Mash the bananas in a bowl and stir in the melted butter.
Mix in the sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the batter and stir, then fold in the flour until just combined.
Bake 55 to 65 minutes, until a skewer in the middle comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the pan.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a small bowl.
Beat the butter and both sugars until creamy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture, then the chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 9 to 11 minutes, until golden at the edges. Cool 2 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack.

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Zest and juice one lemon. Mix the zest and juice with the garlic, oil, thyme, salt and pepper.
Toss the chicken in the mixture and lay it skin side up in a baking dish. Slice the second lemon and tuck the slices around the chicken.
Roast 35 to 40 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the thickest piece reads 175°F (80°C).
Rest 5 minutes and spoon the pan juices over before serving.

title: Sunday Pancakes
ingredient_lines: 3 tbsp butter, melted, plus more for the pan
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg and melted butter in another bowl.
Pour the wet into the dry and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a griddle over medium heat and butter it lightly.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter per pancake. Flip when bubbles pop on top and the edges look set, about 2 minutes, then cook 1 to 2 minutes more.

title: Tomato Soup
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, the stock and the sugar. Simmer 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream if using, and season with salt and pepper.

title: Weeknight Fried Rice
steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large pan over high heat. Scramble the eggs, then move them to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and the peas and carrots. Cook 2 minutes.
Add the rice, break up any clumps, and fry 3 to 4 minutes.
Return the eggs, add the soy sauce and green onions, and toss.
Take off the heat and stir in the sesame oil.
